cb333cc6: Plain advice for everyone who joins a tour or a social, and how to tell us when something is wrong.
3da0a7e1: Never send money, gift cards or bank details to someone you have met online or on a tour, whatever the reason given.
71ce9ee8: Pay iLoveLatins only through the methods Sam gives you directly. If a message about payment looks odd, call and check before you pay.
bb5df658: If anyone asks you for money, tell Sam.
70d2dced: Check that your passport is valid and read your government’s current travel advice for Colombia before you book.
2148d04c: Buy travel insurance that covers medical care and cancellation.
520b4dee: Leave a copy of your itinerary and hotel details with someone at home.
182a7373: Use the hotel safe. Carry a copy of your passport and only the cash you need for the day.
9d88de04: Use registered taxis or ride apps, and ask the host if you are unsure about an area.
429bb087: Go easy on alcohol and never leave a drink unattended.
d3218a03: Meet in public places first. The socials exist for exactly this.
0f43da48: Tell the host or a friend where you are going if you make plans outside the group.
683bc5ab: Everyone on a tour is an adult and is there by choice. Respect a no, in any language.
ac5fd55d: Participar es gratis. Nadie de iLoveLatins te pedirá dinero.
90215b59: Conoce a las personas primero en los eventos o en lugares públicos, y cuéntale a alguien de confianza a dónde vas.
7103a995: No compartas tu dirección ni tus datos bancarios.
fbd296dc: Si alguien te hace sentir incómoda, díselo al anfitrión o escríbenos.
2bff84ab: Use the contact page and choose “Report a profile or a concern”, or call or text Sam at . Every report is looked into, and profiles reported as fake or suspicious are removed.
80c65b49: In an emergency in Colombia, dial 123.
